drivers: Alternating two-operation rule (+5, ×3) is a common pattern and recognizable from differences
Arithmetic is simple (small additions, ×3 on two-digit numbers) and easily verified without calculator
Close distractors (91, 93, 94) punish sloppy guessing but don't help partial-rule solvers
70-second limit is adequate but pressure may hurt those who try to find a single operation first
